sentences.text: IPMA forecasts a 100% chance of rain in Faro today, with a minimum of 19.8 °C and a maximum of 22.4 °C.
Portimão, Loulé and Sagres also have a 100% chance of rain today.
A yellow warning for rough sea covers the Faro district from 2026-11-18 17:19 to 2026-11-20 09:00 local time.
On 2026-11-19, IPMA forecasts waves of 3.4 to 3.9 metres from NW on the Sagres coast, with a sea temperature of 19 to 19.1 °C.
On 2026-11-19, IPMA forecasts waves of 0.6 to 1.3 metres from W on the Faro coast, with a sea temperature of 19.2 to 19.7 °C.
Faro's chance of rain falls to 6% tomorrow, with a minimum of 12.4 °C and a maximum of 20.7 °C.
Portimão's chance of rain is 0% tomorrow, with a minimum of 11.5 °C and a maximum of 20.4 °C.
